content.title: The Hollow Vigil
content.theme: A moorland keep where the last warden keeps a vow the dead refuse to release.
content.premise: Barrowmere Keep has held its vigil for two hundred years — long after anyone remembered what it guarded against. Now the old garrison has risen hollow from the barrow-earth, and Warden Maren, last of her order, is too old to put them down. Someone must quiet the halls, take back the barrow key, unlock the deep door, and end the vigil where it began: at the altar in the great hall, where the First Warden stands his post long past death.
